We have a function Music_3_LookupMusic that can retrieve a list of songs based on artist, album, genre, year. The user wants Hillbilly songs. There's no "Hillbilly" genre in the function's genre options. The function's genre options are: "Reggae", "Holiday", "Electropop", "Pop", "Asia", "House", "Electronica", "Funk", "Rock", "Metal", "Dubstep", "Country", "dontcare". Hillbilly is a subgenre of country. So we can set genre to "Country" to get country songs. The user specifically wants songs from the album Chief by Eric Church. So we can set artist to "Eric Church", album to "Chief", genre to "Country". That should return songs from that album. The user also wants "some Hillbilly songs".
